text.en:
While aiming-down-sights at an Enemy:
Rockets track enemies. <pvp [Diminshed effectiveness in PVP] />

Tracking persists for 1 second after not aiming at the enemy.

enhanced (
#e Passively grants 5 Blast Radius.
)
text.zh-chs:
当瞄准敌人时：
火箭可追踪敌人 <pvp [PVP 时追踪效果减弱] />

取消瞄准时，追踪效果持续 1 秒。

enhanced (
#e 被动提升 +5 爆炸范围。
)
